attribution.title: Les maisons de bouteilles - Bottle Houses - The six gabled house (2)
attribution.author: A Disappearing Act
attribution.description: Les Maisons de bouteilles (The Bottle Houses) is a roadside attraction located at 6891, Route 11, in Cap-Egmont, Prince Edward Island, Canada. The three structures were built from 1980 to 1983 out of approximately 25,000 glass bottles. They were created by Édouard T. Arsenault (1941 - 1984), an Acadian fisherman and World War II veteran from Prince Edward Island
